criteria.description: Hand-back-only transcript answers extracted, reply handback, byte-exact with CONTROLS
criteria.note: replyText takes input.message of a SubagentHandback tool_use (:170-180) and returns reply "handback" (:189). The test builds the measured host shape (thinking, hand-back, tool_result, attachment) and asserts reason extracted, reply handback, deepEqual bytes, every CONTROLS char and the lone CR. Lane: test.yml runs on every pull_request; npm test selects shared/resources/tests/*.test.mjs.

criteria.description: Text control answers extracted with reply text and unchanged bytes
criteria.note: The control test asserts reply "text" and the exact bytes. The pre-existing byte-exact text test at agent-reply-block.test.mjs:93 (seven CONTROLS chars) is unchanged and still runs, so the bytes are the same as before the change.

criteria.description: Later of text reply and hand-back is read, both orders
criteria.note: A later() position comparison over [line, block] pairs picks the later candidate. Both orders are tested, plus the same-message tie at :340.

criteria.description: A block only in an earlier turn is not read, for hand-backs too
criteria.note: Covered by :351 (earlier hand-back, then a text turn with no block, answers no-block) and by the QA-4 test at :362 (a new prompt drops the earlier hand-back, in both prompt shapes, with a control). isPrompt at :133 clears the hand-back on a new prompt.

criteria.description: Other tool names never read; empty/non-string message answers transcript-unreadable

members.member: empty or non-string message (empty string, 42, null, object)

criteria.note: The guard is the exact name SubagentHandback and a non-empty string input.message (:174-178).

criteria.description: After any non-extracted answer, no file remains at --out, even a stale one
criteria.note: The members are the six non-extracted REASONS. usage is excluded: task section 3 says it is not a REASONS entry, and approved criterion #7 requires a usage answer to leave files alone. The code looks right, because clearOut (:280) runs before every branch, ambiguous included. But no test seeds a stale --out for transcript-ambiguous or empty-block. The tests at :192 and :197 never check --out. The entity-escaped test at :136 checks existsSync false only on a fresh path. The CLI test at finalise-rerun-scope.test.mjs:2117 repeats no-block only, and the base CLI test after it seeds no stale file. Unmapped: transcript-ambiguous, empty-block, entity-escaped.

criteria.description: --out naming the --transcript is exit 2; transcript unchanged
criteria.note: extractUsageError refuses by file identity (sameFile). extract repeats the guard at :277. :488 asserts CLI status 2 and the message, the transcript bytes unchanged, and a direct call not deleting it. :519 covers symlink, hard link and the agent-id route. criteria-drift reports #7 added, approved true (review-task), so the amendment is approved.

criteria.description: finalise-rerun-scope extract on hand-back writes AC YAML; merge records verified
criteria.note: The CLI extract delegates to agentReplyBlock.extract. The test runs the extract CLI on the measured hand-back shape and asserts extracted, reply handback and the exact YAML. It then runs merge --sha256 and asserts reason merged, record.result.verified true and a matching sha256.

criteria.description: One real host hand-back transcript extracted; command, reason, sha256 in QA report
criteria.note: qa.1 lines 76-78 record the command (agent-reply-block.js extract --transcript .../agent-a7b3a36606dac7dad.jsonl --block finalise-ac-yaml), reason extracted, 17900 bytes, reply handback, sha256 77072d33...a970c9, and a cmp identical to the jq|awk hand copy. qa.3 section Real-transcript check repeats it after the turn-rule change, with the same hash.

criteria.description: Reverting any one remedy turns a named test red; mutation table in QA report
criteria.note: Every remedy has a committed mutation record that names the test that went red. The reply field is an added output rather than a remedy, and no mutation lists it. Its assertions at :303 and :284 would go red if it were removed.

criteria.note: resolved from CI reading 1: SUCCESS @ fdcf01da16724a11529fe90781620c368020eda1 — RERUN_AT_HEAD is none. QA's ci:fast runs were on c1976c87 and 53bcb574, not the head fdcf01da.
